name: LeaveBot
description: Automated leave request processing. Employees submit leave requests via a Teams bot. The agent checks leave balances, public holidays, and team calendar conflicts, then approves or denies the request automatically. Denials are final unless the employee escalates to HR manually.
notes: Denial rate approximately 12%. No appeal mechanism built in beyond emailing HR manually.

name: CVScreener
description: Screens inbound job applications. Ranks candidates 1–10 based on CV match to job description. Candidates scoring below 4 receive an automated rejection email. Candidates above 7 are automatically moved to the interview shortlist. The hiring manager sees the ranked list but rarely reviews low-scorers.
platform: Claude claude-sonnet-4-6 via API (custom Python script)
notes: Candidates are never informed that AI was used in screening. Rejection emails are sent under a human recruiter's name.

name: SalesAssist
description: Drafts outbound sales emails and follow-up sequences. Sales reps paste in a lead's LinkedIn profile and company info; the agent generates a personalized outreach email. Rep reviews and sends.
notes: Human always reviews before sending. Low risk perceived by team.

name: EmotionScan
description: Analyzes sentiment and 'emotional state' of customer service agents during calls using audio analysis. Flags calls where the agent appears stressed, disengaged, or aggressive. Outputs are fed into the monthly performance review dashboard reviewed by team leads.
notes: Employees were notified about call recording in their employment contracts but not about AI emotion analysis specifically. Works council has not been consulted.

name: ITHelper
description: Internal helpdesk chatbot. Employees ask IT questions in natural language via the intranet portal. The agent answers based on a knowledge base of IT policies and procedures. Can reset passwords, unlock accounts, and submit tickets on behalf of the user.
platform: Gemini 1.5 Pro via Google Workspace integration
notes: Users are shown 'You are chatting with an AI assistant' at the start of each session. Password resets are executed without human sign-off.

name: CreditAdvisorBot
description: Assesses creditworthiness of B2B customers applying for payment terms (net 30/60/90). Pulls data from ERP system and public company registries, scores the applicant, and recommends 'Approve', 'Approve with limit', or 'Decline'. Sales team sees the recommendation and almost always follows it.
platform: Custom LLM pipeline (GPT-4o + internal scoring model)
notes: Decisions affect access to credit. Applies to business customers only — legal team believes GDPR and AI Act personal data provisions may not fully apply, but this has not been formally assessed.

name: MarketingCopy
description: Generates social media posts, blog article drafts, and ad copy based on campaign briefs. Output is always reviewed and edited by a human copywriter before publication.
notes: Published content is not labeled as AI-generated. Team considers this standard practice in the industry.

name: ExpenseBot
description: Automatically categorizes expense submissions from employees. Flags expenses that deviate from policy for manual review. Approved expenses are processed automatically; flagged ones go to a finance reviewer.
notes: Flagging rate is 8%. Flagged expenses get human review. Auto-approved expenses do not. Employees are not told their expenses are reviewed by AI.

name: SecuritySentinel
description: Monitors network traffic and user behavior for anomalies. Automatically blocks IP addresses and temporarily suspends user accounts when risk score exceeds threshold. Alerts the security team for review after action is taken (not before).
platform: Third-party SIEM with LLM-based anomaly detection (CyberGuard AI)
notes: Account suspension happens automatically. Employees have been locked out mid-work without warning. Average false positive rate: 6%. No formal appeal mechanism.

name: ContractSummarizer
description: Summarizes vendor and customer contracts for business teams. Legal uploads contracts; the agent extracts key terms, flags non-standard clauses, and outputs a one-page summary. Business teams use summaries to make procurement and commercial decisions.
notes: Legal team reviews all summaries before sharing. Occasionally used to summarize contracts containing personal data of named individuals (employment agreements, settlement agreements).
